lines.beaver_en: Did you climb the mountain yesterday? How was the summit?
lines.en: Far from the summit, I just got lost deep in the mountains.

lines.beaver_en: Oh no, but the view was nice, right?
lines.en: Nice view? Not at all. The soil was sliding down, so it was scary.

lines.beaver_en: Then it must have been pretty at night. Did you see the moonlight?
lines.en: It was a crescent moon, so there was hardly any moonlight.

lines.beaver_en: Ah, too bad. How was the beach?
lines.en: The coast had lots of pebbles and no sand.

lines.beaver_en: What about the sea offshore? They said the water was clear.
lines.en: Far from clear, I couldn't see anything underwater.

lines.beaver_en: Weren't the waves at least pretty?
lines.en: Far from pretty, the waves were just rough because of the wind.

lines.beaver_en: The hotel garden was okay, right? It has a pond.
lines.en: There was a pond, but the fountain was broken.

lines.beaver_en: Haha, you really had bad luck. And the weather?
lines.en: The sun was so hot it felt like a desert.

lines.beaver_en: Still, you'll remember it for life.
lines.learner: 맞아. 세상은 넓으니까 다음엔 다른 데 가자.
lines.en: True. The world is big, so let's go somewhere else next time.
lines.roman: maja. sesangeun neolbeunikka daeumen dareun de gaja.

lines.beaver_en: Okay! You pick the next trip.
lines.learner: 알았어. 이번엔 내 판단을 믿어 봐!
lines.en: Got it. This time, trust my judgment!
lines.roman: arasseo. ibeonen nae pandaneul mideo bwa!
